description: Published values compared in the paper (comparison table). Units: percent. "published" is a value or a [low, high] range. "measured" names the run quantity computed by scripts/e14_compare.py (fractions, converted to percent). Delta = this work - published (percentage points); relative delta = Delta / published. Protocols differ per row as stated.

references.BODMAS: L. Yang, A. Ciptadi, I. Laziuk, A. Ahmadzadeh, and G. Wang, "BODMAS: An open dataset for learning based temporal analysis of PE malware," in Proc. IEEE Secur. Privacy Workshops (SPW), 2021, pp. 78-84, doi: 10.1109/SPW53761.2021.00020.

references.D3QN: Khan, Al-Tamimi, Bermak, and Khalil, "Adaptive malware detection using sequential feature selection: A dueling double deep Q-Network framework for intelligent classification," J. Inf. Secur. Appl., vol. 99, art. 104407, 2026, doi: 10.1016/j.jisa.2026.104407 (given names to be confirmed at the publisher).
references.Ghiani: D. Ghiani et al., "Regression-aware continual learning for Android malware detection," IEEE Trans. Inf. Forensics Security, vol. 21, pp. 6845-6854, 2026, doi: 10.1109/TIFS.2026.3714132.
